messages:
paul: Quick ping — PM RED-3001 has two remediation items still open and past the due date. Need owners to confirm status or reassign today so I can close the tracker.

ana: I own RED-8120 (tweak pool backoff + metrics). Was blocked on a staging perf dump, I pulled it this morning and started a tiny config PR. ETA 3pm.

chris: I'm listed for RED-8133 (alert thresholds + synthetic). Draft synthetic exists but I need infra to grant read access to a new metric stream. Filed INC-6012.

infra-bot: Reminder: RED-8120 due 2026-05-10 (assigned to ana). RED-8133 due 2026-05-09 (assigned to chris). INC-6012 pending approval.

paul: If INC-6012 isn't approved by noon I'll escalate to infra leads. This PM flagged the same pattern twice; want to avoid letting this linger.

ana: PR up: https://git.redwood.ai/pull/9577. Small config change, added notes and a verification step (48h no connection errors). Please review. Commit: b4c1a2f.

infra-bot: INC-6012 approved by cloud-admins. Change logged 2026-05-06T11:05Z.

chris: Access granted 1 Thanks. Synthetic pushed and PR merged: commit e9d3f5c. Linked RED-8133 and updated runbook at https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/pool-synth. Set ticket to "Ready for Verify".

oncall-bot: Automation: RED-3001 follow-ups scheduled for verification checks (48h).

paul: Two final asks before closing: 1) paste exact deployment windows in the tickets; 2) infra please add any permanent quota or permission changes to the infra change log entry.

ana: Deployment recorded in RED-8120: 2026-05-06 14:00 UTC. No rollback needed (stateless).

infra-bot: Quota/permission changes logged in INC-6012 change record with rationale.

paul: Great. I'll mark the PM cluster closed and add a note about adding a monthly capacity sanity check to prevent recurrence. If anything reopens ping me. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Action: Postmortem follow-ups for RED-3001 marked CLOSED by paul.

ana: Thanks everyone.

chris: Closing my side.

paul: Thread closed.
